metadata.description: Session-rail mods for Claude Code: plan usage limits and a todo stack that survives compaction.

plugins.name: usage-rail
plugins.description: Shows plan usage limits (5-hour, weekly), context fill and session cost in a pane on the session rail.

plugins.name: todo-stack
plugins.description: Stacks every todo the model creates, request by request, in a pane on the session rail so none is lost to compaction.
